about_the_game:
---

Apartment Complex Daytime Security Guard Position Available

Working hours: 8:00-18:00, trial period: 2 weeks. There are mainly 3 security rules:

  • Always greet the residents.

  • Always have visitors write their real names on the visitor list.

  • Never speak to the woman in white robes.

---

10 Days as a Daytime Security Guard at a Cursed Apartment Complex

"Zakuro Danchi" is an adventure game where you work as a security guard on day shifts from 8:00 to 18:00 for 10 days.

Whether you faithfully perform your duties as a corporate cog, build human relationships through interactions with residents and visitors, or investigate various objects to uncover the truth about Zakuro Danchi—it's all up to you.

※Please be sure to follow the rules.

10 Days of Security Work Within Time Constraints

In-game time progresses in real-time (selectable from 20, 40, or 60 seconds) for each hour.

(Time pauses during certain commands and event occurrences.)

Players can move between the security office and inside the apartment, performing the following actions:

What You Can Do in the Security Office

◎Monitor security camera footage

If you discover any abnormalities, patrol immediately.

◎Check visitor lists and resident lists

Always have visitors write their real names on the visitor list.

Increasing intimacy with residents through interaction unlocks resident information.

◎Converse with residents and visitors

Always greet the residents.

◎Handle phone calls

If you notice any abnormalities or irregularities, report them to the management company.

What You Can Do Inside the Apartment

◎Patrol each floor and rooftop, respond to abnormal incidents

If you notice any unusual or abnormal behavior, report it to the management company.

Also, be sure to patrol the property at 3 p.m.

Rule Violations Erode "Normalcy"

Security guards are bound by several rules, and violations increase the "Spiritual Disturbance Level."

The Spiritual Disturbance Level has 5 stages, and reaching Level 5 renders the player unable to act.

Secrets Hidden Behind Visitors and Residents

Residents and visitors basically perform set actions on specific days at specific times.

However, player intervention may cause changes in their behavior.

Whether you face their past and emotional wounds is—up to you.

Endings Branch Significantly Based on Your Actions

The story branches into multiple routes depending on the player's actions, rule compliance, and relationships with residents.

Some events and endings only occur when specific conditions are met.

Special events may occur on weekends... Multiple endings exist, with completely different developments depending on the route reached.

—Why. Why are you in such a place?

content_descriptors.notes:
This game includes:
Psychological horror elements and supernatural themes
Depictions of character disappearances and mysterious incidents
Themes involving family dysfunction, neglect, and psychological trauma
Religious cult activities and their psychological impact on characters
Mental health struggles and disturbing behavior
Supernatural possession and unexplained phenomena

Note: This game does not contain sexual content, graphic violence, or excessive gore.
There are no depictions of sexual assault, non-consensual sex, or drug abuse.
While the game touches on themes of mental distress, it does not provide explicit depictions of self-harm methods.
